BrochureContent.Content:
Kelly Hudson Properties proudly present this 2 bedroom ground floor apartment to the market for sale. 

This apartment offers ample bright, airy, spacious living accommodation and comes to the market in good clean and tidy condition and has been well maintained by its current owners. The property briefly comprises of the light filled entrance hallway, kitchen/dining, large living room, two large bedrooms, the main of which is ensuite and the large family sized bathroom. The apartment overlooks a large green area to the front and rear ideal for recreational activities. Both bedrooms offer direct access to the green area to the rear. 

The property is conveniently located only a short walk from Newbridge town and close to all local amenities. These include schools, shops, bars, restaurants, Banks, Whitewater Shopping Centre, Newbridge Silverware and much more. The town has a superb bus service, train station and access to the motorway is only a stones throw making this an ideal choice for any commuter. 

Viewing is highly recommended by prior appointment only. 

ACCOMMODATION:

Entrance Hallway: Wooden flooring, storage heater and radiator cover, hot press with shelving and storage 

Kitchen/Dining: Tiled flooring, light fitting, fully fitted kitchen, area fully plumbed, stainless steel sink, oven, hob, extractor fan

Living Room: Wooden flooring, feature fireplace with stove

Master Bedroom: Wooden flooring, fitted wardrobe, direct doorway access to large outdoor green/common area, storage heater 

Ensuite: Tiled flooring, tiled surround, corner shower, WHB, WC, shaving light and socket 

Bedroom 2: Wooden flooring, fitted wardrobe, direct doorway access to large outdoor green/common area, storage heater 

Family Bathroom: Tiled flooring, tiled surround, bath, separate shower, WHB, WC, shaving light and socket 

Features:

Management fees approx. 2,200 p.a.
Two (X2) undesignated car parking spaces per apartment 
Selected curtains, blinds and light fittings included
